title: Remove selected header elements and Call Now button

requirements.summary: Remove the anchor element and its child SVG icon from the Header component's third div group
acceptanceCriteria: The anchor element at the specified XPath no longer exists in the rendered header
The SVG icon inside that anchor no longer exists in the rendered header
No broken layout or empty space left where the removed elements were

file_operations.description: Remove the anchor element and its child SVG icon located in the third div group of the header's first div. Locate the element structure matching /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] and remove both the <a> wrapper and the <svg> element inside it. Ensure the surrounding layout remains intact with no empty space or broken styling.

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Call Now' button or link from the Header component while preserving the FloatingCallButton
acceptanceCriteria: No 'Call Now' text, button, or link is visible in the header
The FloatingCallButton component in App.tsx (the floating fixed button) is NOT removed — only the header Call Now element is removed
Header layout remains clean and properly aligned after removal

file_operations.description: Remove the 'Call Now' button or link element from the Header component markup. This is separate from the FloatingCallButton component (which must remain untouched). Locate and remove only the header-specific Call Now element, ensuring the header layout remains properly aligned and no visual artifacts are left behind.
